Main text in one column: italic question headings each followed by a paragraph, then a rule, then the division heading for the seventh title, with its German subtitle in black letter. Gathering mark "F" at the foot.

main_text.p: Cùm aliquis simul & civitatem & libertatem amittit, quod accidit in his, qui servi poenæ efficiuntur atrocitate sententiæ.§.maxima.inst.eod.

head.i: Quid est minor sive media capitis Deminutio?

main_text.p: Cùm civitas quidem amittitur, libertas verò retinetur: quod accidit ei, cui aqua & igni interdictum fuerit, der in die acht gethan wirð: vel ei qui in Insulam deportatus est, der in ein Insel verweist ist. §. minor.ind.eod.

Cùm civitas retinetur & libertas, sed status hominis commutatur: quod accidit in his, qui cùm sui juris fuerint, coeperunt alieno juri subjecti esse, vel contrà. Veluti si filiusfamilias à parte emancipatus fuerit, est capite deminutus.§ minima.inst.eod.
Si minima capitis Deminutio interveniat, manet cognatio: si maxima capitis Deminutio interveniat: jus cognationis perit, ut puta servitute alicujus cognati.§.quod autem.inst.eod.
Non simul ad omnes pertinet, sed ad eos tantùm qui sunt proximiores gradu: vel si plures ejusdem gradus sunt, ad omnes pertinet.§ final.inst.eod.
main_text.head: QUIS EST DECIMUS septimus Titulus? De legitima patronorum tutela. Von Rechtmässiger vormundtschaffe der schutzvätter.

page.notes: The initial "Q" of "QUIS" and the large "V" of "Von" are enlarged display letters, read as Q and V. Black letter used for the German words in the body and the title. The horizontal rule above the division heading is decorative, not text. The "F" below the heading is a gathering signature. The printed page number 449 is at top right.
